services.name: Tent & RV Sites
services.desc: Here at Sunbanks Resort even the tent camping and RV sites are coveted vacation spots. These sites are surrounded by lush greenery and offer plenty of shade throughout the season. Campers will appreciate the beautifully landscaped grounds and picturesque weeping willow trees. Waterfront tent and RV sites allow campers to access the lake from the comfort of their own campsites. The tent and RV sites are located throughout the entire resort area, providing a variety of surroundings suitable for any camper’s taste. services.desc: Karaoke, DJ or Open Mic night in the Cantina on Friday and Saturday nights starts at 8pm If the festival atmosphere seems a little too high energy for you and your family, why not try Friday Night Karaoke on the Sunbanks Resort in the Cantina. Friday Night Karaoke is an opportunity for both parents and children to hang out and sing their hearts out. For those who don’t feel like singing - there’s no reason not to relax with a picnic on the grass. Every Friday night during peak season The Sunbanks Resort hosts a family karaoke night at the main stage located east of the lodge. blurb: Sunbanks Lake Resort is the most unique lake resort destination in Eastern Washington. Located on beautiful Banks Lake near Grand Coulee, Sunbanks has miles of natural scenic beauty ideal for camping, watersports, fishing, or any type of outdoor activity. Need a place to stay? Experience the lake view villas and cabins, or camp in the beautiful tent or RV sites.
